headline: Base Swaps Intensify on Six Fronts as Losses Rise
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the fighting has sharpened on a half‑dozen sectors. Callahans Passage has added roughly 11,400 Colonial and 13,300 Warden dead, 748 fresh enlistees and 79 ownership changes, three in the past two hours. Weathered Expanse reports another 12,600 Colonial and 18,300 Warden casualties, 557 recruits and 31 base flips, five recorded in the last two hours. Nevish Line surged to 6,600 new Colonial and 6,500 Warden losses, 849 enlistments and 17 ownership shifts, four of them very recent. Stonecradle saw 1,600 Colonial and 2,900 Warden casualties, 392 recruits and seven flips, all seven occurring in the last two hours. Linn Mercy recorded 2,800 Colonial and 6,200 Warden dead, 468 enlistees and six flips, three in the past two hours. Mooring County added 3,500 Colonial and 3,600 Warden casualties, 618 recruits and twelve flips, two very recent. Elsewhere the map is largely static, with only modest casualty drift and no base‑ownership movement.
